source: DESIGN_SPEC.md four-distance table + ONE RETURN contract (void-anchor/sleeper/README.md); painting borrowed from /sleeper/borrowed-river/landscape.jpg (sha256 7b1e50ff…); city matter is P. A. Payutto's Buddhadhamma, free online edition (buddhadhamma.github.io), Section 7 'Path Factors' chapters 16-18, retrieved 2026-10-25 and projected into /sleeper/ladder/source-dhamma.json — the raw text stays local in void-anchor/sleeper/corpus/buddhadhamma/

contract.identity: two content hashes, both printed: painting tag f0f09635 = hash32(id+sha256(painting bytes)); source fingerprint bbbe96ac = hash32('buddhadhamma@1|'+sha256(selected text))
contract.recomposition: route -> hash32(tag|U/D/L/R witness) -> visited-tile tone inside a measured band + a hairline trace of the walked path
contract.rest: empty route recomposes to the original pixels (mad64 = 0, changedPx = 0)
contract.witness: compressed U/D/L/R string; blocked steps never enter it; returning to the origin coordinate completes the run
contract.matter: paragraph = district, sentence = building, word = room, character = material, punctuation = rain/window/lamp/beacon; 28 districts / 50 buildings / 1,228 drawn rooms of 1,257
contract.learning: eight gates ask one word of the district's own cited line (three doors, two wrong answers shut the gate for the walk); a clock-free ledger quotes a line you walked before after five other district visits

changes: MATTER: the city is now built of Buddhadhamma — the shipped artifact is a derived projection (provenance + selection sha256 + 3,072 characters of matter + per-cell source coordinates + one cited line per district), never the book's text

DERIVATION: sleeper/ladder/derive-source.mjs re-runs PROVENANCE -> SELECTION -> MAPPING -> PROJECTION from the local corpus; the selftest requires the shipped file to be its output byte for byte and a different selection to change the fingerprint

MAPPING: parseSource split sentences at terminators (not at ')'), and measures punctuation with Unicode word classes so ā/ṭ/ṇ stay matter — the old ASCII \w turned the last letter of every Pali word into weather
GAME: eight gates that verify understanding, one diagetic meter (eight lamps on the frame, 0..8, monotone), return prompts from a clock-free reading ledger, reveal-on-touch loupe
REDUCED: header, status readout, primary button, four-detent rail, moiré identity strip, decode DOM panel and gap panel are gone — canvas + one provenance line + an sr-only live region
NEAR now draws the WHOLE 96x32 frame in the painting's own box (a crop lost the composition); legibility is bought with a 9x9 loupe on hold

validation.selftest: PASS: node sleeper/ladder/ladder-selftest.mjs — 65 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (synthetic painting; derivation arms re-run against the local corpus)
validation.browser: PASS: Chromium 390x844 dpr2 — touch tap FAR->NEAR->ENTERED, touch hold decode, keyboard walk to a gate across 9 steps, gate answered at a door (lamp lit), return prompt after 13 districts, origin retrieval -> EXITED, tap to RETURN
validation.determinism: same route twice -> identical sha256 (57fd475d…); different route -> different sha256 (4c137147…); empty witness -> mad64 0 and changedPx 0; source fingerprint bbbe96ac reproduced from the corpus, window 8 gives 81585e34

limits: NEAR cannot show 96 columns of legible characters on a phone: the composition is carried by tone and glyph texture, and legibility is bought with the loupe (a named resolution trade, not a hidden filter)
The book is under reserved distribution rights: only the sampled projection and one cited line per district are public; the source URL is printed as text, never as an anchor
The recomposition bakes visited tiles plus the walked trace; it does not re-paint brushwork, so a long straight route reads as a drawn line
The eight lamps reset each walk; only the reading ledger persists (localStorage, keyed by source schema)
Determinism is proven on the natural-size pixel buffer; display resampling at other DPRs is outside the contract
